name: circle_match_cut_ticks
description: Preset extracted from the reference video (pencil -> mask reveal -> eye -> circular-object match cuts on clock ticks -> eye closes). Exported 9:16 but the edit itself is a 16:9 frame.

reference_analysis.container: MP4 (H.264 High, yuv420p) + AAC HE-AAC 44.1 kHz stereo
reference_analysis.edit_frame: 16:9 frame placed in the upper half of the canvas (y ~193..595), timeline shown below it

shot_list.shot: Hand writing with a pen in a notebook (wide, shallow depth of field)
Page flip used as a MASK REVEAL into the eye
Extreme close-up of an eye (iris centred)
Back to the eye -> eye closes (end)

editing_rules.concept: Every match shot has ONE circular object at the exact centre of the frame, at about the same size as the iris, so each cut feels like the same shape turning into something else.

outro.shot: same eye as the first match shot
outro.ending: eye closes / quick fade to black

editing_rules.eye_detail: adjustment layer on the last eye shot (extra sharpening/contrast on the iris)
editing_rules.framing: subject centred; circle diameter about 35-45% of frame height; push-in/scale so each circle matches the previous one

color_grade.look: warm, filmic, slightly desaturated shadows, soft contrast

layers.name: riser
layers.notes: builds from start to the final eye; drops when the eye closes

layers.name: ticks
layers.span: from the mask reveal to the end
layers.notes: one clock tick on each cut, every 0.5 s

layers.name: per-shot SFX
layers.span: one short sound for each object (globe, lens, guitar, flame, tea boiling)

sound_design.target_loudness: about -14 LUFS for social media; peaks below -1 dBTP

export.vertical_option: 1080x1920 with the 16:9 edit centred on black
